== Summary ==
[[1998 Decipher World Championship]], Cavalier Hotel, Virginia Beach, Virginia, 20–22 November 1998. Scrapbook page from the same Hunter family album as the other 1998 Worlds scrapbook pages. Top: three boys seated in the hall, with the handwritten caption "Eric, Hayes" ([[Eric Hunter]] and [[Hayes Hunter]]; the caption doesn't mark which boys they are). Bottom: a visitor wearing a Star Wars CCG "Guest" badge and a Jabba "Visitor" name badge.

== Source ==
Photographed album page posted by [[Hayes Hunter]] in the Players Committee Slack, 7 April 2020 ("My mom is downsizing. Pictures (and captions) from Worlds 1998 and MA states 2000"), channel C4BHV1KTK, message p1586279248461000 (the Slack workspace is private, so the message has no public archive copy).
